text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although we lost the Unity Cup, the hard fight our team put up helped open Riko Kashimoto's eyes and save her and her team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa thanks us for our efforts. I vow that <chrname> and I will continue to do our best.
